newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Jan 29 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, no vessels in roads, no vessels due. Max. draft 29 ft. 7 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, no vessels in roads, no vessels due. Max. draft 29 ft. 7 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading linex, 1 loading sbm, 1 loading wheat, 1 loading sbmp, 1 loading sunflower. 7 Vessels in roads, 18 due at 6 terminals during the week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary in the next week. Pasa berth draft - 24 ft. 6 in. Fw.

Rosario - Five vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 1 discharging steel products, 1 discharging fertiliser, 1 loading sbmp. 4 Vessels in roads, 9 due during the coming week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary in the next week. Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed, 1 in roads, 3 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. Fw. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - Four vessels berthed of which 2 discharging steel products, 1 loading zinc, 1 discharging coke. 1 Vessel in roads, 7 due during the week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel.

San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in roads. Draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Max. draft for Mitre channel at high tide is as follows, vessels up to 22 metres beam - 32 ft. 0 in. Fw, vessels over 22 metres beam - 31 ft. 6 in. Fw. Buenos Aires - 14 vessels in port, 22 due. Max. draft 31 ft. 6 in. Fw. At high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud draft - 29 ft. Fw. At high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel).

Necochea - Four vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 1 loading maize, 1 loading sbmp. 7 Vessels in roads, 10 due during the week. Depth at zero at the access channel is 37 ft. 4 in. Fw. Max. sailing draft at high tide is 40 ft0 in. Fw. with special permission of Coast Guard. Bahia Blanca - Four vessels berthed of which 3 loading wheat, 1 discharging ethylene. 1 Vessel in roads, 15 due during the week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, Jan 28 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 bulk malt discharger, 3 container/general cargo loaders/dischargers, 1 pig iron loader. Tubarao - 1 iron ore loader. Praia Mole - 2 Steel products loaders. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - 1 Iron ore loader. Nine vessels waiting in roads. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 4 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 1 wheat discharger, 1 bulker, 1 salt discharger, 3 steel products dischargers, 1 bulker discharger, 3 steel products/general cargo loaders, 3 sugar loaders.

Tecon - 2 Vessels. 29 Vessels due during next 7 days. Santos - Vessels berthed - 1 Bulk gasoline loader, 4 full containers, 2 general cargoes, 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 bulk cement discharger, 2 bulk wheat dischargers, 1 bulk coal loader, 1 vehicle discharger/loader, 1 bulk pellets loader. 11 Vessels waiting in roads, 76 due during next 7 days. Cosipa - 1 Iron ore loader, 3 steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 2 Vessels berthed. Commercial Quay - 1 vessel berthed. Three vessels waiting in roads, 4 due during next 7 days.

Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 bulk fertiliser discharger, 2 general cargo dischargers, 2 container dischargers, 2 bulk pellets loaders, 2 general cargo loaders. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 general cargo, 1 fertiliser. 27 Vessels due during next days. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 1 bulk fertiliser discharger, 2 full container loaders, 1 soya loader, 1 general cargo, 1 chemical products discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 1 petroleum discharger, 1 fuel discharger. 1 Vessel waiting in roads, 10 due during next 10 days.

CHILE, Jan 27 - Arica - One vessel working normally, 4 berths vacant, 13 vessels due. Iquique - One vessel working normally, 1 berth vacant, 7 vessels due. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant, 16 vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, copper bulk, containers and general cargo. 1 Vessel awaiting cargo in roads. Valparaiso - Seven vessels berthed, working normally. 1 Berth vacant, 1 berth out of service, 15 vessels due. San Antonio - Seven vessels operating, 3 berths vacant. 16 Vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel, working normally, 2 vessels due, no vessels in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels waiting in roads, 7 due. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 2 Vessels due during the week. Steel pier - 2 Vessels berthed. Coronel pier - No vessels in terminal. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel in terminal, none due. Lirquen - Four vessels berthed, 4 berths vacant, 3 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels in terminal. Puerto Montt - Two coasters berthed, no vessels in roads, 5 due during the week. Punta Arenas - Three vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 5 vessels due during the week.

PERU, Jan 27 - Callao - Five vessels in bay, 6 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - One fishmeal vessel in pier, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels. Talara - Four oil vessels in bay, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fishmeal vessel in bay, no berthing delays. Ilo - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier (oil) no delays.

VENEZUELA, Jan 27 - Puerto Cabello - Two vessels anchored, 6 vessels berthed of which 2 grain cargo, 2 general cargo, 2 container vessels. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - 4 Vessels anchored, 2 general cargo vessels berthed.

Jan 28, Orinoco river - Draft 30 ft. 6 in. Puerto Ordaz - One vessel loading iron ore, 5 vessels due. Mile 178 - Three vessels waiting at anchorage. Palua - Two vessels due. San Felix - One vessel loading aluminium. Boca Grande - Two vessels due. Venalum - One vessel loading aluminium. Interalumina - Two vessels loading alumina. Matanzas - Five vessels loading steel products, 5 vessels due. Punta Cuchillo - Two vessels due. La Guaira - Three vessels loading/discharging generals, 4 due, 3 under repair. Puerto Cabello - Nine vessels operating of which 8 loading/discharging generals, 1 discharging bary, 17 vessels due. Guanta - Three vessels due. Maracaibo - One vessel waiting at anchorage

El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea. La Salina - One vessel loading crude oil. Punta Camacho - One vessel loading crude oil. Bajo Grande - One vessel loading crude oil, 2 vessels due. No vessels at buoy B71, Palmarejo Sur, Punta Palma, San Lorenzo, San Francisco, La Ceiba. Amuay - Three vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels loading refined products. Cardon - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 loading refined products. All ports working normally.
